metadata.description: Plugins for building a portable PKM knowledge graph from MOCs, atomic notes, meaningful internal links, tags, and companion coaching assets.

plugins.name: create-domain-moc
plugins.description: Create or revise one domain Map of Content that defines scope and provides descriptive navigation to atomic notes.

plugins.name: create-atomic-note
plugins.description: Create or revise one atomic note and connect it to a domain Map of Content with meaningful internal links and filtering tags.

plugins.name: create-coaching-note
plugins.description: Create or revise a supportive coaching companion for one atomic knowledge note.

plugins.name: create-obsidian-marp-slides
plugins.description: Create or update one domain's shared Obsidian Marp presentation from its MOC and atomic notes, adding speaker notes when coaching companions exist.
